ArrayStep

By Subahini Nadarajh · Version 0.1.0

Independent study lessons for Python, algorithms, math, machine learning, AI and software engineering. AI-assisted content should be checked against your course and tested before use.

Your notes, drafts, quiz results and progress stay on your device. This app has no advertising, analytics, accounts or live AI service. Removing app or browser data can erase progress; export a backup to keep it.

Opening LeetCode uses an external service with its own terms and privacy practices. No LeetCode problem statements, logos, user submissions or datasets are bundled.

The hosted private web trial uses ChatGPT access controls. The packaged mobile app loads its lessons from the app bundle and needs no ChatGPT login.

Use ArrayStep on your phone

iPhone: open this URL in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.

Android: open in Chrome and use Install app or Add to Home screen if offered.

This is a web trial, not an App Store or Google Play release. Private sign-in may be required. Python examples are for study; this trial does not execute Python.
